wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 05-006 wires the digital sound effect lumps (DS-prefixed, from linuxdoom-1.10 i_sound.c sprintf(name, "ds%s")) and the MUS music lumps (D_-prefixed, from S_StartMusic/S_ChangeMusic) into a runtime catalog the audio subsystem consumes. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/soundAndMusicAssets.ts walks the IwadResourceCache directory partitioning every committed lump into the SFX (DS-prefixed) and MUS (D_-prefixed) buckets, preserving directory order and reporting each entry with its canonical DirectoryEntry reference. The catalog embeds NO proprietary IWAD sample or score bytes — it tells the audio subsystem WHICH entries are available, leaving sample/score decoding to the mixer / MUS scheduler. Zero-size lumps are skipped to match the I_CacheSFX size > 0 guard.
